methodology.preseason_weight: Elo K=2 vs regular-season K=18 (~11%); preseason rating offset decays exp(-team_games/5)
methodology.trend: Current-season completed games update Elo after every final
methodology.previous_season_srs: Prior-year SRS contributes to opening model and decays as games accumulate
methodology.expected_wins: Sum of game-by-game pre-tipoff win probabilities
methodology.picked_wins: Number of games with pre-tipoff probability >50%
methodology.opening82: Opening-night 82-game estimate versus an equally weighted league opponent pool, 50% home games
methodology.updated82: Actual wins so far plus estimated win probability over remaining games versus a balanced league pool; not the real remaining schedule
methodology.caution: Projections do not account for injuries, transactions or exact future schedule; not calibrated betting odds
